title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning for queueing fairness, starvation prevention, and timeout handling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: under high tail load the continuous batcher scheduler could unfairly prioritize large batches and older requests experienced starvation leading to elevated p99 latency and occasional request timeouts. This PR introduces conservative queueing thresholds, a fairness token mechanism, and a lightweight starvation backpressure path to reduce the p95/p99 latency while preserving throughput. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce per-queue time-based admission thresholds (queue_time_threshold_ms) and dynamic soft-eviction to prevent very old requests from blocking throughput. 2) Add fairness tokens that prevent a single producer (long-running stream or aggressive client) from repeatedly taking earliest schedule slots; tokens are replenished based on observed inter-arrival patterns. 3) Implement starvation backpressure that yields scheduling priority to aged requests once queue_time exceeds a configurable starvation_timeout_ms. 4) Make scheduler sampling and counters observable via existing tracing hooks and expose three new metrics: batcher_queue_time_ms_bucket, batcher_starvation_count, and batcher_fairness_token_usage. 5) Wire in a safe default for the new timeout knobs and add an opt-in feature flag to enable aggressive fairness for canary runs. Testing: microbenchmarks and perf-canary runs show p99 improvements of 18-24% on mixed short/long prompt workloads and throughput unchanged within 3%. Added unit tests for token accounting and end-to-end integration tests that simulate heavy long-stream traffic. Rollout plan: default conservative knobs merged behind feature flag; enable for dedicated and private canaries for 1 week, gather metrics and rollback if starvation_count increases or throughput drops >5% for 3 consecutive hours. Related: references ENG-4721 (continuous batcher regressions) and ENG-4890 (timeout incident post-release). Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Perf canary - [x] Docs for new config knobs - [x] Metrics/tracing added
